purpose: actual three-node relay with same-cache native implementation controls

roles.A: You are Agent A, an evidence reader. Using only your supplied material, extract the entities and facts relevant to the question. State what the evidence supports in at most three short sentences. Do not invent missing facts.

material_policy: first supporting-fact title to A; remaining titles to B
